bear_assumptions: Fiscal-2027 revenue reaches the USD 5.9147 billion guidance floor, free-cash-flow margin normalizes to 26%, and 45x FCF plus USD 3.807 billion net cash is divided by 1.06 billion split-adjusted diluted shares; growth and cash conversion slow while incident, competition and equity-compensation costs persist.
base_assumptions: Fiscal-2027 revenue reaches the USD 5.9367 billion guidance midpoint, free-cash-flow margin is 31%, and 60x FCF plus USD 3.807 billion net cash is divided by 1.05 billion split-adjusted diluted shares; ARR and module adoption remain durable while dilution moderates only gradually.
bull_assumptions: Fiscal-2027 revenue reaches the USD 5.9587 billion guidance ceiling, free-cash-flow margin holds at 34%, and 75x FCF plus USD 3.807 billion net cash is divided by 1.04 billion split-adjusted diluted shares; high-end growth persists while incident costs and dilution ease.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a fresh scenario set after fiscal Q2 evidence clears expected-return, base-upside, bear/base, expected/bear and margin-of-safety gates at the then-current price while ARR, retention, module adoption, GAAP economics and per-share cash conversion remain sound; downgrade the thesis if renewal quality, trust, competitive position, cash conversion or dilution deteriorates.
